identity_note: Matched Jutro Medical Sp. z o.o. (jutromedical.com), the Warsaw-based NFZ-funded primary-care clinic network founded by Adam Janczewski. Website, sector (medical) and Poland HQ all match the batch entry; no competing company of the same name surfaced.

profile.name: Jutro Medical
profile.description: Polish primary-care (POZ) clinic operator funded by the National Health Fund (NFZ): patients book free teleconsultations or in-person visits and get prescriptions and results in its app, with in-house AI tools supporting doctors. It grows by building clinics and by buying existing ones, often from retiring doctors.
profile.location: Warsaw, Poland (HQ at Powązkowska 44); clinics in Warsaw, Poznań/Suchy Las, Wrocław, Kraków, Gdańsk and other Polish cities. No US presence found.
profile.funding_detail: About PLN 151M raised in equity and debt (Forbes Polska, May 2026). Latest: PLN 101M (~EUR 23-24M) Series A extension announced Dec 2025, led by Warsaw Equity Group with Vinci (BGK group), plus naturalX Health Ventures, Fluent Ventures, Aternus, KAYA VC, Inovo VC and healthcare angels; ~85% equity / 15% debt from Orbit Capital and mBank. Earlier: EUR 12M Series A (Mar 2025, KAYA VC and RIO ASI leads, with Inovo VC); first round PLN 1.7M (Kogito Ventures and others).
profile.headcount: LinkedIn band 501-1,000 (126 employees on LinkedIn); Forbes Polska (May 2026): ~70 at HQ and ~800 including clinic staff
profile.past_completed_deals: 17 clinics acquired to date out of 29 total (Forbes Polska, May 2026), including six acquired in April 2026; seven acquisition transactions in 2025 added nine locations (XYZ.pl, Dec 2025). Acquired clinic names not disclosed. Acquisitions run through subsidiary Medola Centrum Medyczne, which has an mBank acquisition facility.
profile.open_role: No open roles found as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Active acquirer of Polish clinics · no corp dev seat open
verdict.detail: 17 clinics bought (6 in April 2026), aiming at a dozen-plus a year; founder-CEO Adam Janczewski runs the roll-up. Outside the US/Canada scope.
